messages:
Ivy K: Massive thanks to @Jonas P and @Rina S for jumping on the flaky endpoint during the partner demo. You two were the calm in the chaos. :sparkling_heart:
Jonas P: Thanks! Team jumped fast. Rina had the hotfix in under 12 minutes.
Rina S: Couldnt have done it without Carlos rerouting the test traffic. 
Carlos M: Happy to help. Also big props to @Ivy K for coordinating with the partner PM so they didnt see the errors.
Ivy K: Tribute snack run tomorrow? I can bring donuts if people want. Quick poll: plain or chocolate? React :doughnut: or :chocolate_bar:
Jonas P: :doughnut:
Rina S: :chocolate_bar:
Carlos M: Either works for me, will be there.
ops-bot: A shoutout card (Kudos #9207) was generated and tagged for the next recognition round.
Ivy K: Also, Rina — can you paste the tiny patch you pushed so I can link it in the incident notes?
Rina S: Sure, gist of the fix:
```
# fix: guard against empty cache key
if not cache_key:
    return fallback_response()
# ensure upstream timeout lowered for partner route
upstream.timeout = 1.5
```
Carlos M: Adding a note to run a small canary on partner route tomorrow morning at 8:15.
Ivy K: Thanks team. Seriously appreciate the late pivot. See you at the snack table. :raised_hands:
